name: EU AI Act
description: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation 2024/1689) - Comprehensive framework for the development, deployment, and use of AI systems within the European Union

policies.requirement_ref: Article 13 - Transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems
policies.requirement_description: AI systems must provide clear information about their AI nature and capabilities to users. Content generated by AI must be disclosed as such.
High-risk AI systems shall be designed to allow effective human oversight during the period of use, including the ability to intervene or halt operation.
A risk management system shall be established and maintained for high-risk AI systems, including identification and mitigation of foreseeable risks.
Training, validation, and testing data sets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices relevant to the intended purpose.
Providers of high-risk AI systems shall report any serious incident to the market surveillance authorities within defined timelines.
